statistical_concerns.issue: Error-bar convention is not consistent within a single comparison.
statistical_concerns.detail: ch7:242 (0.5211 +/- 0.0201) and ch7:259 (0.0579 +/- 0.0034) are POPULATION std (ddof=0); ch7:284 (0.497 +/- 0.035) is SAMPLE std (ddof=1) -- recomputed ddof=0 for the control is 0.0286. The three are compared as a 'three-way agreement' in the same paragraph. Nothing in the draft defines whether +/- is std, sem or CI.
statistical_concerns.fix: Declare the convention once and apply it; with n=3 seeds, report the three values.

statistical_concerns.issue: A quoted CI has no artifact.
statistical_concerns.detail: The weak-labeller MCC interval [-0.1040, +0.0966] (ch5:312, ch8:354) exists only in CORRECTIONS C58 and the .tex. results/accord/stats/intervals.json holds four systems and not this one. Independent recomputation from the C53 cells reproduces it in substance ([-0.1016, 0.097], 0 degenerate draws) but not to the printed digits, because the seed is unrecorded. This is the C48 pattern.
statistical_concerns.fix: Persist the computation; ch8's own table caption still says it was never computed.

statistical_concerns.issue: Degenerate bootstrap is handled in one place and undocumented in others.
statistical_concerns.detail: intervals.json E3 records draws_dropped_zero_positives=20 (0.2%) and reports a stratified CI beside the unstratified one -- correct practice. The AUROC CI [0.321, 0.703] on 12 positives, and the four MCC CIs, do not report a degenerate-draw count. With 12 positives in 253, resamples with 0 positives are possible and MCC's denominator vanishes on any resample with an empty predicted or actual class.
statistical_concerns.fix: Report n_valid / n_dropped for every bootstrap, as E3 already does.

statistical_concerns.issue: DeLong is used correctly for the correlated-AUROC comparison.
statistical_concerns.detail: control/final_report.json carries delong_ensemble_vs_accord and per-seed DeLong tests on the same 299 pairs (p = 0.930 gold_all). This is the right test for two AUROCs on shared data. It is not cited in ch7's three-way agreement paragraph, which asserts agreement by eye instead.
statistical_concerns.fix: Cite the DeLong p-values at ch7:285-287.

statistical_concerns.detail: ch7 reports 4 AUROC treatments, a 7-row per-rule/per-stratum AUROC table (defect_free_strata.json), 2 Spearman tests, 4 MCC intervals, and a 3-row threshold sweep. Per-rule AUROCs range 0.2262 (rule 2, n=31) to 0.6514 (rule 1, n=134) with no correction and no interval. The artifact's own caveat says these are 'individually unreliable'; ch7 does not repeat that caveat at the point of use.
statistical_concerns.fix: State the family size, or restrict reporting to the two pre-specified strata.

statistical_concerns.issue: A p-value and CI are quoted for a stratum whose configuration was superseded.
statistical_concerns.detail: The defect-free AUROC 0.5078 with p=0.953 (ch1:192, ch7, ch10:75) is computed on the CONTAMINATED scores -- the same file whose 'ALL' row is 0.4602, which C16 retired. It is quoted in the Introduction and Conclusion beside the DECONTAMINATED 0.5145 with no indication they come from different models. The decontaminated defect-free numbers exist (control/final_report.json: 0.5417 / 0.5352 / 0.5117, ensemble 0.5469).
statistical_concerns.fix: Either report the decontaminated defect-free values or dagger 0.5078 in ch1 and ch10 as ch7:245 already does.

statistical_concerns.issue: n=3 seeds is the entire basis for every +/- in the evaluation chapter.
statistical_concerns.detail: Three seeds support the precision, recall, AUROC, AP and alpha intervals. Seeds are reported (42/123/2024 for the control; 0/1/2 for the decontaminated run) which is good practice, but no test is run across seeds and the std of 3 values is quoted to four significant figures.
statistical_concerns.fix: Report the three values, not a 4-s.f. std.
